groups.name: Intro
groups.blurb: A gentle start: small boards and the easiest puzzles, one shape at a time. Every one needs only "this cell can only be covered one way".

groups.name: One shape
groups.blurb: Every tile is the same shape, with very few black cells, like the original L-panel puzzles. Mostly Medium and Hard.

groups.name: Two shapes
groups.blurb: Each tile is either of two shapes, with very few black cells. Mostly Hard.

groups.name: Experiments
groups.blurb: Experimental. Sparse boards that have a few distinct tilings, made unique by an edge or two drawn for you (in black, like the blocked cells).

groups.name: Experiments, balanced
groups.blurb: Experimental. Few black cells and more pre-drawn clues (lines and ✕ marks) that make the tiling unique.

groups.name: Dense: one shape
groups.blurb: Every tile is the same shape; the boards are denser, with more black cells. Each book runs from Beginner to Hard.

groups.name: Dense: two shapes
groups.blurb: Each tile is either of two shapes; the boards are denser, with more black cells. Each book runs from Beginner to Hard.
